executionPivotPlan.name: Governed Build Invocation Contract And Sandbox Preview Bridge
executionPivotPlan.objective: Define the first execution contract from confirmed build handoff to a preview/run path without letting the drawer write.

executionPivotPlan.name: Sandbox Preview Operator Smoke
executionPivotPlan.objective: Run the build engine manually or through approved operator steps, compare preview output, and return final generated names JSON.

executionPivotPlan.name: Final Generated Names Navigation Integration
executionPivotPlan.objective: Use imported generated names and links in Build and Run as the consultant navigation surface.

executionPivotPlan.name: Controlled Customer And Supporting Record Write Pilot
executionPivotPlan.objective: Enable the first governed write pilot only after preview, confirmation, operator approval, and rollback gates pass.

executionPivotPlan.name: Transaction Creation Safety Gate
executionPivotPlan.objective: Keep transaction creation blocked until customer/supporting records, final naming, idempotency, and rollback behavior are proven.

executionPivotPlan.name: Pilot Execution Go/No-Go
executionPivotPlan.objective: One consultant-to-operator-to-generated-record test with final links returned and no unauthorized write path.
